_comment: SIM-4 Stage B (gate V2a): ONE PX4 x500 with an onboard 640x480 downward camera (model x500_mono_cam_640) flying the PX4-flyable convoy world (convoy_px4) over MAVSDK UDP, --phases sentry_scan, logging MOVING-marker ArUco sightings to sightings.csv. PX4 OWNS the gz server (lockstep -> sensors/EKF healthy) under llvmpipe; convoy_px4.sdf adds the flight-sensor systems convoy.sdf lacks. Frames arrive via sim/gz_camera_bridge (system py3.10 gz subscriber) -> GazeboRgbSource TCP; the bridge subscribes the onboard topic /world/convoy_px4/model/x500_mono_cam_640_0/link/camera_link/sensor/camera/image and MUST be streaming before finals (the run-script gates on its first frame). Drive via sim/run_vision.sh stageB. Single drone falls back to top-level sitl_address + gRPC 50051; SIM-5 ships configs/sitl3_vision.json for 3x. command_timeout_s 30: EKF settle. altitude_band_m 1.7 = the middle sentry band where ArUco decodes (SIM-3). sentry_scan revolutions 2 ~= >1 convoy lap, bounded. gazebo_video_port MUST match the bridge --port. camera_hfov_deg 99.69 = mono_cam_640 HFOV 1.74 rad. detector none: ArUco (marker_backend) is the primary detector; YOLO stays off.
